G2424.def:
**Ἰησοῦς**, -οῦ, dative, voc. -οῦ, accusative, -οῦν (Heb. יֵשׁוּעַ ,יְהֹשֻׁעַ ,יְהוֹשׁוּעַ),
1. **JESUS**: [[Mat.1.21|Mat.1:21]], al.; ὁ Ἰ, [[Mat.3.13|ib. 3:13]], al.; Ἰ. Χριστός, [[Mat.1.1|ib. 1:1]], [[Mrk.1.1|Mrk.1:1]], al.; Χρ. Ἰ., [[Rom.2.26|Rom.2:26]], al.; κύριος Ἰ., [[Act.28.31|Act.28:31]], al.; Ἰησοῦ, voc., [[Mrk.1.24|Mrk.1:24]], al.
2. **Joshua**: [[Act.7.45|Act.7:45]], [[Heb.4.8|Heb.4:8]].
3. **Jesus**, son of Eliezer: [[Luk.3.28|Luk.3:28]]
4. **Jesus**, **surnamed Justus**: [[Col.4.11|Col.4:11]]
5. see: βαραββᾶς.
(AS)

G2464.def:
**Ἰσαάκ**
(in MSS. sometimes -σάκ; cf. Deiss., BS, 189; Thack., _Gr._, 100), ὁ
indecl.
(in FlJ, Ἴσακος, -ου), (Heb. יִצְחָק),
Isaac ([[Gen.17.19|Gen.17:19]], al.): [[Mat.1.2|Mat.1:2]], [[Rom.9.10|Rom.9:10]], al
(AS)

G2455.def:
**Ἰούδας**, -α
dative -ᾳ,
accusative -αν
(so in LXX, and also rarely, Ἰουδά, indecl.; cf. Thack., _Gr._, 163) (Heb. יְהוּדָה)
1. **Judah, son of Jacob**: [[Mat.1.2-3|Mat.1:2-3]], [[Luk.3.33|Luk.3:33]]; φυλή Ἰ., [[Rev.5.5; 7.5|Rev.5:5 7:5]]; by meton., of the tribe, [[Heb.7.14|Heb.7:14]] of its confines, γῆ Ἰ., [[Mat.2.6|Mat.2:6]]πόλις Ἰ., [[Luk.1.39|Luk.1:39]]
2. **Judah **(unknown): [[Luk.3.30|Luk.3:30]]
3. **Judas Iscariot **(see: Ἰσκαριώτης): [[Mat.10.4|Mat.10:4]], [[Mrk.3.19|Mrk.3:19]], [[Luk.6.16|Luk.6:16]], [[Jhn.6.71; 13.2|Jhn.6:71 13:2]], al.
4. **Judas, the Lord's brother **(see: ἀδελφός): [[Mat.13.55|Mat.13:55]], [[Mrk.6.3|Mrk.6:3]] (prob.), [[Jude.1|Ju 1]].
5. **Judas the Apostle, son of James **(see: Θαδδαῖος): [[Luk.6.16|Luk.6:16]], [[Jhn.14.22|Jhn.14:22]], [[Act.1.13|Act.1:13]].
6. **Judas, of Damascus**: [[Act.9.11|Act.9:11]]
7. **Judas, surnamed Βαρσαββᾶς **(which see): [[Act.15.22, 27; 15.32|Act.15:22, 27 15:32]].
8. **Judas the Galilean**: [[Act.5.37|Act.5:37]]
Ἰωδά
(Rec. Ἰούδα)
**Joda**: [[Luk.3.26|Luk.3:26]]†
(AS)

G2488.def:
**Ἰωάθαμ** (WH, -θάμ), ὁ, indecl. (Heb. יוֹתָם),
**Jotham, King of Judah**: [[Mat.1.9|Mat.1:9]]†
(AS)

G2400.def:
**ἰδού**,
[in LXX chiefly for הִנֵּה,]
_prop. imperat. 2 aor. mid. of ὁράω, used as a demonstrative particle_, with frequency much greater in LXX and NT than in cl. (see M, _Pr._, 11),
**lo, behold, see**: [[Mat.10.16; 11.8; 13.3|Mat.10:16 11:8 13:3]], [[Mrk.3.32|Mrk.3:32]], [[Luk.2.48|Luk.2:48]], [[1Co.15.51|1Co.15:51]], [[Jas.5.9|Jas.5:9]], [[Jude.14|Ju 14]], [[Rev.1.7|Rev.1:7]], al.; after genitive absol., [[Mat.1.20; 2.1, 13; 12.46|Mat.1:20 2:1, 13 12:46]], al.; καὶ ἰδού, [[Mat.2.9|Mat.2:9]] (and freq.), [[Luk.1.20; 10.25|Luk.1:20 10:25]], [[Act.12.7|Act.12:7]], al.; in elliptical sentences, taking the place of copula or predicate (like הִנֵּה in Heb.), [[Mat.3.17|Mat.3:17]], [[Luk.5.12; 22.31, 47|Luk.5:12 22:31, 47]] [[Act.8.27, 36|Act.8:27, 36]] al.
(AS)

G2449.def:
§ Judea, Judean, "land of the Judahites"
**Judea,** the southern party of the country, below Samaria, [[Mat.2.1, 5, 22; 3:1|Mt. 2:1, 5, 22; 3:1]]; _metonymy_ **the inhabitants of Judea**

G2414.def:
**Ἱεροσόλυμα** (WH, Ἰερ-, see _Intr._, § 408), -ων, τά (on πᾶσα Ἱ., [[Mat.2.3|Mat.2:3]], see WM, 794; M, _Pr._, 48, 244; Thayer, see word), and Ἱερουσαλήμ (WH, Ἰερ-), ἡ., indecl., as always in LXX exc. some parts of Apocr.. (Heb. יְרוּשָׁלִַם), the former always in FlJ, Mk, Jo EV. and Mt (except. [[Mat.27.37|Mat.27:37]]), and most frequently in Lk, the latter always in He, Re, and by St. Paul (except. [[Gal.1.17-18; 2.1|Gal.1:17-18 2:1]]),
**Jerusalem**: [[Mat.2.1|Mat.2:1]], [[Mrk.3.8|Mrk.3:8]], [[Jhn.1.19|Jhn.1:19]], al.; its inhabitants, [[Mat.2.3; 3.5; 23.37|Mat.2:3 3:5 23:37]], [[Luk.13.34|Luk.13:34]], Symbolically, ἡ- ἄνω Ἱ., [[Gal.4.26|Gal.4:26]], contrasted with ἡ νῦν Ἱ., [[Gal.4.25|Gal.4:25]] Ἱ. ἐπουράνιος, [[Heb.12.22|Heb.12:22]] ἡ καινὴ Ἱ., [[Rev.3.12; 21.2, 10|Rev.3:12 21:2, 10]]
(AS)

G2453.def:
**Ἰουδαῖος**, -αία, -αῖον
(Ἰούδας),
**Jewish**: ἀνήρ, [[Act.10.28; 22.3|Act.10:28 22:3]]; ἄνθρωπος, [[Act.21.39|Act.21:39]] ψευδοπροφήτης, 13:6; ἀσχιερεύς, 19:14; γυνή, 16:1 24:24; γῆ, [[Jhn.3.22|Jhn.3:22]] χώρα, [[Mrk.1.5|Mrk.1:5]] Substantively,
(a) Ἰουδαῖος, ὁ, **a Jew**: [[Jhn.4.9|Jhn.4:9]], [[Act.18.24|Act.18:24]], [[Rom.2.28|Rom.2:28]]; pl., [[Rev.2.9; 3.9|Rev.2:9 3:9]]; οἱ Ἰ., [[Mat.2.2|Mat.2:2]], [[Mrk.7.3|Mrk.7:3]], [[Jhn.2.6|Jhn.2:6]], al.; Ἰ. τε καὶ Ἕλληνες, [[Act.14.1|Act.14:1]], al.; κ. προσήλυτοι, [[Act.2.10|Act.2:10]] ἔθνη τε κ. Ἰ., [[Act.14.5|Act.14:5]] οἱ κατὰ τὰ ἔθνη, [[Act.21.21|Act.21:21]] of Jewish Christians, [[Gal.2.13|Gal.2:13]] of the ruling class who opposed Jesus, [[Jhn.1.19; 2.18; 5.10; 11.8; 13.33|Jhn.1:19 2:18 5:10 11:8 13:33]], al.;
(b) Ἰουδαία, -ας, ἡ (sc. γῆ, χώρα, cf. [[Jhn.3.22|Jhn.3:22]], [[Mrk.1.5|Mrk.1:5]]), (Heb. יְהוּדָה), **Judæa**: [[Mat.2.1|Mat.2:1]], [[Luk.1.5|Luk.1:5]], [[Jhn.4.3|Jhn.4:3]], al.
(AS)

G2474.def:
**Ἰσραήλ** (FlJ, Ἰσράηλος, -ου), ὁ indecl. (Heb. יִשְׂרָאֵל, [[Gen.32.28|Gen.32:28]]),
**Israel**: ὁ οἶκος Ἰ., [[Act.7.42|Act.7:42]] (LXX), al.; λαός, [[Act.4.10|Act.4:10]] υὁοί, [[Act.5.21|Act.5:21]], al.; αἱ φυλαὶ τοῦ Ἰ., [[Mat.19.28|Mat.19:28]], al. By meton., for the Israelites, [[Mat.2.6|Mat.2:6]], [[Luk.1.54|Luk.1:54]], [[Rom.11.2|Rom.11:2]], al.; ὁ λαὸς Ἰ., [[Act.4.10|Act.4:10]] γῆ Ἰ., [[Mat.2.20-21;|Mat.2:20-21]] βασιλεὺς Ἰ., [[Mat.27.42|Mat.27:42]], [[Jhn.1.50|Jhn.1:50]]; ἡ ἐλπὶς τοῦ Ἰ., [[Act.28.20|Act.28:20]] ὁ Ἰ. τοῦ θεοῦ (of Christians), [[Gal.6.16|Gal.6:16]] ὁ Ἰ. κατὰ σάρκα, [[1Co.10.18|1Co.10:18]]
(AS)

G2476.def:
**ἵστημι**, and in late writers, also ἱστάνω (Veitch, see word; Bl., §23, 2; M, _Pr._, 55), [in LXX chiefly for עמד, קוּם, also for נצב ni., hi., יצב hith., etc.].
I. Trans, in pres., impf., fut. and 1 aor. act. and in the tenses of the pass.
1. **to make to stand, to place, set, set up, establish, appoint**: with accusative of person(s), [[Mrk.7.9|Mrk.7:9]], [[Act.1.23; 6.13; 17.31|Act.1:23 6:13 17:31]], [[Heb.10.9|Heb.10:9]]; id. before ἐπί, with accusative loc, [[Mat.4.5|Mat.4:5]], [[Luk.4.9|Luk.4:9]]; ἐν μέσῳ, [[Mat.18.2|Mat.18:2]], [[Mrk.9.36|Mrk.9:36]], Jhn.8:[3]; ἐνώπιον, [[Act.6.6|Act.6:6]] παρ᾽ ἑαυτῷ, [[Luk.9.47|Luk.9:47]] ἐκ δεξιῶν, [[Mat.25.33|Mat.25:33]] mid., **to place oneself, to stand**: [[Rev.18.15|Rev.18:15]] so also pass., **to be made to stand, to stand**: [[Mat.2.9|Mat.2:9]], [[Luk.11.18; 19.8|Luk.11:18 19:8]], [[2Co.13.1|2Co.13:1]], al.
2. **to set in a balance, to weigh** (cl.; LXX for שׁקל, [[Isa.46.6|Isa.46:6]], al.): [[Mat.26.15|Mat.26:15]],
II. Intrans., in pf., plpf. (with sense of present and impf.; M, _Pr._, 147f.) and 2 aor. act., **to stand, stand by, stand still**: [[Mat.20.32; 26.73|Mat.20:32 26:73]], [[Mrk.10.49|Mrk.10:49]], [[Luk.8.44|Luk.8:44]], [[Jhn.1.35; 3.29|Jhn.1:35 3:29]], [[Act.16.9|Act.16:9]], al.; before ἐν, [[Mat.6.5|Mat.6:5]], al.; ἐνώπιον, [[Act.10.30|Act.10:30]], al.; πρός, with dative loc., [[Jhn.18.16|Jhn.18:16]] ἐπί, with genitive loc., [[Luk.6.17|Luk.6:17]], [[Act.5.23; 25.10|Act.5:23 25:10]], al.; ἔμπροσθεν, [[Mat.27.11|Mat.27:11]] κύκλῳ, [[Rev.7.11|Rev.7:11]] ἐκ δεξιῶν, [[Luk.1.11|Luk.1:11]] ἐπί, with accusative, [[Mat.13.2|Mat.13:2]], [[Rev.3.20|Rev.3:20]]; παρά, [[Luk.5.2|Luk.5:2]] ἐκεῖ, [[Mrk.11.5|Mrk.11:5]] ὧδε, [[Mrk.9.1|Mrk.9:1]] ὅπου, [[Mrk.13.14|Mrk.13:14]] ἔξω, [[Mat.12.46|Mat.12:46]] μακρόθεν, [[Luk.18.13|Luk.18:13]] πόρρωθεν, [[Luk.17.12|Luk.17:12]] Metaphorical, **to stand ready, stand firm, be steadfast**: [[1Co.7.37; 10.12|1Co.7:37 10:12]], [[Eph.6.11|Eph.6:11]], [[Eph.6.13|13]] 14, [[Col.4.12|Col.4:12]]; τ. πίστει, [[Rom.11.20|Rom.11:20]] ἐν τ. ἀληθείᾳ, [[Jhn.8.44|Jhn.8:44]] εν τ. χάριτι, [[Rom.5.2|Rom.5:2]] ἐν τ. εὐαγγελίῳ, [[1Co.15.1|1Co.15:1]] (cf. ἀν-, ἐπ-ἀν-, ἐξ-ἀν, ἀνθ-, ἀφ-, δι-, ἐν-, ἐξ-, ἐπ- (-μαι), ἐφ-, κατ-ἐφ-, συν-ἐφ-, καθ-, ἀντι-καθ-, ἀπο-καθ-, μεθ-, παρ-, περι-, προ-, συν-ίστημι).
(AS)

G2408.def:
**Ἰερεμίας** (T, Rec. Ἱερ-; see WH, § 408), -ου, ὁ
Heb. Jeremiah the prophet: [[Mat.2.17; 16.14; 27.9|Mat.2:17 16:14 27:9]] (a ref. to [[Zec.11.13|Zec.11:13]]).†
(AS)

G2491.def:
**Ἰωάνης** (Rec. ννης, which see; cf. Dalman, _Gr._, 142; Tdf., _Pr._, 79; WH, _App._, 159; Bl., §3, 10; 10, 2), **-ου**, dative, -ῃ (but in [[Mat.11.4|Mat.11:4]] [[Luk.7.18, 22|Luk.7:18, 22]] [[Rev.1.1|Rev.1:1]], ει), accusative, -ην, ὁ (Heb. יוֹחָנָן, LXX: Ἰωανάν, [[2Ch.23.1|2Ch.23:1]], al.; -ννάν, [[Jer.40.8|Je 47 (40):8]], al., Aq.), Hellenized form of Ἰωανάν,
**John** ( I [[Est.8.38|Est.8:38]](41)*), viz.,
1. **John** the Baptist: [[Mat.3.1|Mat.3:1]], al.
2. **John** the Apostle, son of Zebedee: [[Mat.4.21|Mat.4:21]], [[Mrk.1.19|Mrk.1:19]], [[Luk.5.10|Luk.5:10]], [[Act.1.13|Act.1:13]], al.
3. The father of St. Peter: [[Jhn.1.43; 21.15-17|Jhn.1:43 21:15-17]].
4. **John** surnamed Mark: [[Act.12.12, 25; 13.5, 13; 15.37|Act.12:12, 25 13:5, 13 15:37]].
5. The writer of the Apocalypse, traditionally identified with 2: [[Rev.1.1, 4, 9|Rev.1:1, 4 9]].
**Ἰωάννης** (D, Ἰωνάθας; see MM, _Exp._, XV; Bl., §10, 2), ὁ,
**John**: [[Act.4.6; 13.5|Act.4:6 13:5]], Tr., WH, [[Rev.22.8|Rev.22:8]] (cf. Ἰωάνης).†
(AS)

G2478.def:
**ἰσχυρός**, -ά, -όν
(ἰσχύω), [in LXX for אֵל, גִּבּוֹר, עָצוּם, חָזַק, etc. ;]
**strong, mighty, powerful**;
(a) **of persons, as to body or spirit**: [[Mat.12.29|Mat.12:29]], [[Mrk.3.27|Mrk.3:27]], [[Luk.11.21-22|Luk.11:21-22]], [[1Co.4.10|1Co.4:10]] (opposite to ἀσθενής), [[Heb.11.34|Heb.11:34]] (ἐν πολέμῳ), [[Rev.5.2; 10.1; 18.21; 19.18|Rev.5:2 10:1 18:21 19:18]]; οἱ πλούσιοι κ. οἱ ἰ, [[Rev.6.15|Rev.6:15]] τὰ ἰ. = oἱ ἰ. (cf. [[4Ki.24.15|4Ki.24:15]]), [[1Co.1.27|1Co.1:27]]; of God (cf. [[Deu.10.17|Deu.10:17]]), [[Rev.18.8|Rev.18:8]]; compar., [[Mat.3.11|Mat.3:11]], [[Mrk.1.7|Mrk.1:7]], [[Luk.11.22|Luk.11:22]], [[1Co.1.25|1Co.1:25]] (τὸ ἀσθενὲς τ. θεοῦ) [[1Co.10.22|1Co.10:22]]
(b) **of things**: λιμός, [[Luk.15.14|Luk.15:14]] ἐπιστολαί ( βαρεῖαι κ. ἰ.), [[2Co.10.10|2Co.10:10]] κραυγή, [[Heb.5.7|Heb.5:7]] φωνή, [[Rev.18.2|Rev.18:2]] παράκλησις, [[Heb.6.18|Heb.6:18]] πόλις, [[Rev.18.10|Rev.18:10]] βρονταί, [[Rev.19.6|Rev.19:6]]†
(AS)

G2425.def:
**ἱκανός**, -ή, -όν
(ἵκω, ἱκάνω, to reach, attain), [in LXX for דַּי, etc. ;]
1. **of persons, suffcient, competent, fit**: with inf., [[Mat.3.11|Mat.3:11]], [[Mrk.1.7|Mrk.1:7]], [[Luk.3.16|Luk.3:16]], [[1Co.15.9|1Co.15:9]], [[2Co.3.6|2Co.3:6]], [[2Ti.2.2|2Ti.2:2]]; before πρός, [[2Co.2.16|2Co.2:16]] before ἵνα, [[Mat.8.8|Mat.8:8]], [[Luk.7.6|Luk.7:6]].
2. **Of things, in number, quantity or size, sufficient, enough, much, many**: absol., ἱκανοί, [[Luk.7.11|Luk.7:11]] (WH, R, omit) [[Luk.8.32|Luk.8:32]], [[Act.12.12; 14.21; 19.19|Act.12:12 14:21 19:19]], [[1Co.11.30|1Co.11:30]]; ὄχλος ἱ., [[Mrk.10.46|Mrk.10:46]], [[Luk.7.12|Luk.7:12]], [[Act.11.24, 26; 19.26|Act.11:24, 26 19:26]]; κλαυθμός, [[Act.20.37|Act.20:37]] ἀργύρια, [[Mat.28.12|Mat.28:12]] λαμπάδες, [[Act.20.8|Act.20:8]] λόγοι, [[Luk.23.9|Luk.23:9]] φῶς, [[Act.22.6|Act.22:6]] ἱ, ἐστιν (cf. לָכֶם רַב, LXX ἱκανούσθω, [[Deu.3.26|Deu.3:26]]), [[Luk.22.38|Luk.22:38]]; τὸ ἱ. ποιεῖν (Lat. satisfacere; cf. [[Jer.48.30|Jer.48:30]]), [[Mrk.15.15|Mrk.15:15]]; τὸ ἱ. λαμβάνειν (Lat. satis accipere; see M, [[Pro.20.1-30|Pro.20:1-30]] f.), [[Act.17.9|Act.17:9]] of time, ἡμέραι ἱ., [[Act.9.23, 43; 18.18; 27.7|Act.9:23, 43 18:18 27:7]]; ἱ. χρόνος, [[Luk.8.27|Luk.8:27]], [[Act.8.11; 14.3; 27.9|Act.8:11 14:3 27:9]]; pl., [[Luk.20.9|Luk.20:9]] ἐκ χρόνων ἱ., [[Luk.23.8|Luk.23:8]] ἀπὸ ἱ. ἐτῶν, [[Rom.15.23|Rom.15:23]] (WH); ἐφ ̓ ἱκανόν (cf. [[2Ma.8.25|2Ma.8:25]]), [[Act.20.11|Act.20:11]].†
(AS)

G2411.def:
**ἱερός**, -ά, όν
[in LXX: [[Ezk.28.18|Eze.28:18]] (מִקְדָּשׁ); τό ἱ, [[1Ch.29.4|1Ch.29:4]] (בַּיִת), [[Ezk.45.19|Eze.45:19]] (עֲזָרָה); very frequently in I [[Est.1.1-58|Est.1:1-58]] -4 Mac ;]
1. in Hom., marvellous, mighty, divine.
2. (Also in Hom, and later cl.) consecrated to the deity, **sacred**: pl., ἱ. γράμματα, [[2Ti.3.15|2Ti.3:15]]
3. As subst.,
(a) (so in Hom.), τὰ ἱ., **sacrifices, sacred rites, sacred things**: [[1Co.9.13|1Co.9:13]]
(b) later, τὸ ἱ.,., **a consecrated or sacred place, a temple**: τ. Ἀρτέμιδος, [[Act.19.27|Act.19:27]] of the temple at Jerusalem, i.e. the entire precincts or some part thereof (as distinct from ὁ ναός, which see, the Sanctuary proper): [[1Co.9.13|1Co.9:13]], and frequently in Gosp. and esp. in Ac, [[Mat.12.6|Mat.12:6]], [[Mrk.13.3|Mrk.13:3]], [[Act.4.1|Act.4:1]], al. (on the use of ἱ. in Imperial Iuser., see Deiss., _LAE_, 380 f.)
(AS)

G2480.def:
**ἰσχύω**
(ἰσχύς), [in LXX for חָזַק, גִּבּוֹר, עָצַם, etc. ;]
1. **to be strong in body**: [[Mat.9.12|Mat.9:12]], [[Mrk.2.17|Mrk.2:17]].
2. **to be powerful, have power, prevail**: [[Act.19.20|Act.19:20]], [[Rev.12.8|Rev.12:8]]; before κατά, with genitive of person(s), [[Act.19.16|Act.19:16]] with inf., **to be able **(MM, _Exp._, xv): [[Mat.8.28; 26.40|Mat.8:28 26:40]], [[Mrk.5.4; 9.18|Mrk.5:4 9:18]] (inf. understood) [[Mrk.14.37|Mrk.14:37]], [[Luk.6.48; 8.43; 13.24; 14.6, 29-30; 16.3; 20.26|Luk.6:48 8:43 13:24 14:6, 29-30 16:3 20:26]], [[Jhn.21.6|Jhn.21:6]], [[Act.6.10; 15.10; 25.7; 27.16|Act.6:10 15:10 25:7 27:16]]; with accusative, [[Php.4.13|Php.4:13]], [[Jas.5.16|Jas.5:16]]; of things, **to avail, be serviceable **(MM, _Exp._, l.with): [[Mat.5.13|Mat.5:13]], [[Gal.5.6|Gal.5:6]], [[Heb.9.17|Heb.9:17]] (cf. ἐν-, ἐξ-, ἐπ-, κατ-ισχύω).†
(AS)

G2440.def:
**ἱμάτιον**, -ου, τό
(dim, of εἷμα, a garment), [in LXX chiefly for בֶּגֶד also for שִׂמְלָה, שַׂלְמָה, etc. ;]
a garment, but in usage always (exc. in p1., see infr.) of an outer garment, **a mantle, cloak **(thrown over the χιτών; see Rutherford, _NPhr._, 22; _DCG_, i, 499a): [[Mat.9.16, 20-21|Mat.9:16, 20-21]] [[Mrk.2.21; 5.27-28, 30|Mrk.2:21 5:27-28, 30]] [[Jhn.19.2|Jhn.19:2]], [[Act.12.8|Act.12:8]], al.; opposite to χιτών, [[Mat.5.40|Mat.5:40]], [[Luk.6.29|Luk.6:29]], [[Act.9.39|Act.9:39]]; pl., garments, clothes (i.e. the cloak and the tunic), [[Mat.17.2; 26.65; 27.31, 35|Mat.17:2 26:65 27:31, 35]], [[Mrk.5.30; 15.20, 24|Mrk.5:30 15:20, 24]], [[Jhn.19.23-24|Jhn.19:23-24]], [[Jas.5.2|Jas.5:2]], al
(AS)

G2486.def:
**ἰχθύς**, -ύoς, ὁ
[in LXX for דָּג, דָּגָה ;]
**a fish**: [[Mat.7.10|Mat.7:10]], [[Mrk.6.38|Mrk.6:38]], al.
(AS)

G2409.def:
**ἱερεύς**, -έως, ὁ
(ἱερός), [in LXX for כָּהֵן ;]
**a priest**: ἱ. τ. Διός, [[Act.14.13|Act.14:13]] of Jewish priests, [[Mat.8.4; 12.4-5|Mat.8:4 12:4-5]], [[Mrk.1.44; 2.26|Mrk.1:44 2:26]], [[Luk.1.5; 5.14|Luk.1:5 5:14]], [[Jhn.1.19|Jhn.1:19]], [[Heb.8.4|Heb.8:4]], al.; of Christ, [[Heb.5.6|Heb.5:6]] (LXX) [[Heb.10.21|Heb.10:21]] of Christians, [[Rev.1.6; 5.10; 20.6|Rev.1:6 5:10 20:6]] (Cremer, 293; on the accusative pl., ἱερεῖς, see Thack., _Gr._, 147 f.; Bl., § 8, 2)
(AS)

G2469.def:
**ἰσκαριώθ**, ὁ indecl.
([[Mrk.3.19; 14.10|Mrk.3:19 14:10]], [[Luk.6.16|Luk.6:16]], elsewhere -ιώτης; V. infr.) and Ἰσκαριώτης, -ου (Heb. prob. קִרְיָא אִישׁ; see Swete, _Mk._, 319),
**Iscariot**: surname of Judas, ll. with supr., also [[Mat.10.4; 26.14|Mat.10:4 26:14]], [[Mrk.14.43|Mrk.14:43]] (WH, R, omit), [[Luk.22.3|Luk.22:3]], [[Jhn.12.4; 13.2; 14.22|Jhn.12:4 13:2 14:22]]; of his father Simon, [[Jhn.6.71; 13.26|Jhn.6:71 13:26]].†
(AS)

G2436.def:
**ἵλεως**, -ων
(Att.. for ἵλαος), [in LXX for חָלִיל, [[1Ki.14.45|1Ki.14:45]], [[2Sa.20.20|2Ki.20:20]], al.; ἵ. εἶναι, סָלַח, [[3Ki.8.30|3Ki.8:30]] ff. [[Jer.31.34|Jer.31:34]], al. ;]
**propitious, merciful**: τ. ἀδικίαες, [[Heb.8.12|Heb.8:12]] (Je, l.with; cf.1 Ki, l.with); ἵ. σοι (sc. ἔστω ὁ θεός), [[Mat.16.22|Mat.16:22]] (cf. 1Sam, l.with).†
(AS)

G2470.def:
**ἴσος**
(epic ἶσος, so sometimes Rec.), -η, -ον, [in LXX for כְּ֜, [[Job.5.14|Jb 5:14]]; [[Job.10.10|Job.10:10]], al.; אֶחָד, [[Ezk.40.5|Eze.40:5]] ff.; [[2Ma.9.15|2Ma.9:15]], [[4Ma.13.20-21|4Ma.13:20-21]], al. ;]
equal, the same in size, number, quality, etc.: δωρεά, [[Act.11.17|Act.11:17]] μαρτυρίαι, [[Mrk.14.56, 59|Mrk.14:56, 59]]; ἴ. ποιεῖν, with accusative and dative, [[Mat.20.12|Mat.20:12]] ἑαυτὸν τ. θεῷ, [[Jhn.5.18|Jhn.5:18]] τὰ ἴ. ἀπολαβεῖν, [[Luk.6.34|Luk.6:34]], n. pl., ἴσα, adverbially, [[Rev.21.16|Rev.21:16]] τ. θεῷ, [[Php.2.6|Php.2:6]]†
(AS)

G2419.def:
**Ἱερουσαλήμ**, see: Ἱεροσόλυμα - (WH, Ἰερ-, see _Intr._, § 408), -ων, τά (on πᾶσα Ἱ., [[Mat.2.3|Mat.2:3]], see WM, 794; M, _Pr._, 48, 244; Thayer, see word), and Ἱερουσαλήμ (WH, Ἰερ-), ἡ., indecl., as always in LXX exc. some parts of Apocr.. (Heb. יְרוּשָׁלִַם), the former always in FlJ, Mk, Jo EV. and Mt (except. [[Mat.27.37|Mat.27:37]]), and most frequently in Lk, the latter always in He, Re, and by St. Paul (except. [[Gal.1.17-18; 2.1|Gal.1:17-18 2:1]]),
**Jerusalem**: [[Mat.2.1|Mat.2:1]], [[Mrk.3.8|Mrk.3:8]], [[Jhn.1.19|Jhn.1:19]], al.; its inhabitants, [[Mat.2.3; 3.5; 23.37|Mat.2:3 3:5 23:37]], [[Luk.13.34|Luk.13:34]], Symbolically, ἡ- ἄνω Ἱ., [[Gal.4.26|Gal.4:26]], contrasted with ἡ νῦν Ἱ., [[Gal.4.25|Gal.4:25]] Ἱ. ἐπουράνιος, [[Heb.12.22|Heb.12:22]] ἡ καινὴ Ἱ., [[Rev.3.12; 21.2, 10|Rev.3:12 21:2, 10]]
(AS)

G2415.def:
**Ἱεροσολυμεῖτης** (WH, Ἰερ-; Rec. -μίτης), -ου, ὁ,
[in LXX: [[Sir.50.27|Sir.50:27]] (28) [[2Ma.4.22|2Ma.4:22]] [[2Mac.4.39|2Mac 4:39]] (V* -μήτης) [[2Ma.18.5|2Ma 18:5]]* ;]
**an inhabitant of Jerusalem**: [[Mrk.1.5|Mrk.1:5]], [[Jhn.7.25|Jhn.7:25]].†
(AS)

G2438.def:
**ἱμάς**, -άντος, ὁ
[in LXX: [[Isa.5.27|Isa.5:27]] (שְׂרוֹךְ), [[Sir.33.26|Sir.33:26]], [[4Ma.9.11|4Ma.9:11]], al ;]
**a thong, strap**: for binding prisoners (Ma, Sir, ll. with), [[Act.22.25|Act.22:25]] for fastening sandals, Mk, [[Luk.3.16|Luk.3:16]], [[Jhn.1.27|Jhn.1:27]].†
(AS)

G2401.def:
**Ἰδουμαία**, -ας, ἡ
(Heb. אֱדֹם), [in LXX: [[2Sa.8.14|2Ki.8:14]], a1.; elsewhere, as [[Gen.25.30|Gen.25:30]], Ἐδώμ ;]
**Idumæa**: [[Mrk.3.8|Mrk.3:8]]†
(AS)

G2439.def:
**ἱματίζω**
(ἱμάτιον),
**to clothe**: [[Mrk.5.15|Mrk.5:15]], [[Luk.8.35|Luk.8:35]] (elsewhere only in π.; cf. MM, _Exp._, xv; Deiss., _LAE_, 78 f.).†
(AS)

G2479.def:
**ἰσχύς**, -ύος, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for כֹּחַ, also for חַיִל, עַז, גְּבוּרָה, etc. ;]
**strength, might, power, force, ability**: [[Rev.5.12; 7.12|Rev.5:12 7:12]]; ἰ. κ. δύναμις, [[2Pe.2.11|2Pe.2:11]] τ. κράτος τῆς ἰ. ([[Isa.40.26|Isa.40:26]]), [[Eph.1.19; 6.10|Eph.1:19 6:10]]; ἡ δόξα τῆς ἰ., [[2Th.1.9|2Th.1:9]] ἐξ ἰ., [[1Pe.4.11|1Pe.4:11]] ἐν ὅλῃ τ. ἰ., [[Mrk.12.30, 33|Mrk.12:30, 33]]" (LXX) [[Luk.10.27|Luk.10:27]] (LXX).†
_SYN._: δύναμις (which see, and cf. _ICC_, [[Php.4.13|Php.4:13]]); κράτος (cf. M, _Th._, I, 1:9) (AS)

G2407.def:
**ἱερατεύω**
(cl. = ἱεράομαι) [in LXX chiefly for כָּהַן pi. ;]
**to be a priest, officiate as a priest**: [[Luk.1.8|Luk.1:8]] (the word is frequently in Inscr.; see LS, see word; Deiss., BS, 215; _LAE_, 70; Cremer, 734).†
(AS)

G2405.def:
**ἱερατεία** (WH, -ία), -ας, ἡ
(ἱερατεύω), [in LXX for כָּהַן pi., כְּהֻנָּה ([[Exo.29.9|Exo.29:9]], al.), exc. [[Hos.3.4|Hos.3:4]] (אֵפוֹד)* ;]
**priesthood, office of priest**: [[Luk.1.9|Luk.1:9]], [[Heb.7.5|Heb.7:5]].†
(AS)

G2484.def:
**Ἰτουραῖος**, -αία, -αῖον
[in LXX: [[1Ch.5.19|1Ch.5:19]] A (יְטוּר) * ;]
Ituræan (in cl. always ὁι Ἰ., the Ituræans) χώρα (ἡ Ἰτουραίων ὀρεινή, τὰ τῶν Ἰ. μέρη, Strabo, XVI, ii, 16, 20), [[Luk.3.1|Luk.3:1]] (cf. _Exp._ (1894), ix, 51 ff., 143 ff., 288 ff.).†
(AS)

G2433.def:
**ἱλάσκομαι**
(ἵλαος = ἵλεως) [in LXX (cf. Westc., _Epp. Jo._, 85 f.) for סָלַח, [[4Ki.5.18 24:4|4Ki.5:18 24:4]], [[Psa.25.11|Psa.25:11]], [[Lam.3.42|La 3:42]], Da TH [[Dan.9.19|Dan.9:19]] כָּפַר pi., [[Psa.65.3; 78.38; 79.9|Psa.65:3 78:38 79:9]]; נָחַם ni., [[Exo.32.14|Exo.32:14]], [[Est.4.17|Est.4:17]] * ;]
1. in cl., with accusative of person(s), to conciliate, appease, propitiate (= ἐξιλάσκομαι, [[Gen.32.20|Gen.32:20]], [[Pro.16.14|Pro.16:14]], [[Mal.1.9|Mal.1:9]], al.).
2. In LXX (Thackeray, _Gr._, 270, 1.), Inscr. (Deiss., BS, 224 f.), and NT, to be propitious, merciful (with dative of thing(s), [[Psa.79.9|Psa.79:9]], al.): with dative of person(s) ([[4Ki.5.18|4Ki.5:18]]), [[Luk.18.13|Luk.18:13]].
3. As in Philo (= ἐξιλάσκ-, in LXX: [[Ezk.43.22|Eze.43:22]], al.), **to expiate, make propitiation for**: τ. ἁμαρτίας, [[Heb.2.17|Heb.2:17]] (Cremer, 301 ff., 735).†
(AS)

G2481.def:
**ἴσως**
(ἴσσς),
_adv._, [in LXX for אוּלַי, אַךְ, הֵן, [[Gen.32.20|Gen.32:20]], [[Jer.5.4|Jer.5:4]], al. ;]
1. equally.
2. **perhaps**: [[Luk.20.13|Luk.20:13]]†
(AS)

G2475.def:
**Ἰσραηλείτης**
(Rec. -λίτης), ου, ὁ [in LXX: [[Num.25.8|Num.25:8]] (יִשְׂרָאֵל), [[1Ki.21.1|3Ki.21:1]] (יִזְרְעֵאלִי; Luc. Ἰεζραηλίτης), etc. ;]
**an Israelite, the name expressive of theocratic privilege **(see: Ἑβραῖος): [[Rom.9.4; 11.1|Rom.9:4 11:1]], [[2Co.11.22|2Co.11:22]]; ἀληθῶς Ἰ., [[Jhn.1.48|Jhn.1:48]] ἄνδρες Ἰ., [[Act.2.22; 3.12; 5.35; 13.16; 21.23|Act.2:22 3:12 5:35 13:16 21:23]].†
(AS)

G2459.def:
**Ἰοῦστος**, -ου, ὁ
**Justus, the surname of, **
1. **Joseph Barsabbas**: [[Act.1.23|Act.1:23]]
2. **Titus, of Corinth**: [[Act.18.7|Act.18:7]]
3. **Jesus, a Christian of Rome**: [[Col.4.11|Col.4:11]]†
(AS)

G2460.def:
**ἱππεύς**, -έως (on accusative pl., -εῖς, ν. BI., § 8, 2; Thack., _Gr._, 148), ὁ
(ἵππος), [in LXX chiefly for פָּרָשׁ ;]
**a horseman**: [[Act.23.23, 32|Act.23:23, 32]].†
(AS)

G2467.def:
- to know, see, understand
Occurs as Perfect with Present meaning

G2416.def:
**ἱερο-συλέω**, -ῶ
(ἱερόσυλος, which see), [in LXX: [[2Ma.9.2|2Ma.9:2]] * ;]
**to rob a temple **(commit sacrilege, R, mg.): [[Rom.2.22|Rom.2:22]]†
(AS)

G2447.def:
**ἰός**, -οῦ, ὁ
[in LXX: [[Ezk.24.6, 11-12|Eze.24:6, 11-12]] (חֶלְאָה), [[Psa.140.3|Psa.140:3]] (חֵמָה), al. ;]
1. an arrow.
2. **rust **(Ez, l.with): [[Jas.5.3|Jas.5:3]] (cf. MM, _Exp._, xv).
3. **poison**: figuratively, [[Rom.3.13|Rom.3:13]] (Ps. l.with), [[Jas.3.8|Jas.3:8]]†
(AS)

G2435.def:
**ἱλαστήριος**, -α, -ον
(ἱλάσκομαι), [in LXX: [[4Ma.17.22|4Ma.17:22]] neut., [[Exo.25.16|Exo.25:16]] (17) ff. [[Exo.31.7; 35.12; 37.6|Exo.31:7 35:12 37:6]] ff., [[Lev.16.2, 13|Lev.16:2, 13]] ff. [[Num.7.89|Num.7:89]] (כַּפֹּרֶת), [[Ezk.43.14, 17; 43.20|Eze.43:14, 17 43:20]] (עֲזָרָה) [[Amo.9.1|Amo.9:1]] (on the original here, see Deiss., BS, 127)* ;]
**propitiatory **(μνῆμα, FlJ, _Ant._, xvi, 7, 1; θάνατος, 2Mac, l.with): of Christ, [[Rom.3.25|Rom.3:25]] as subst., το ἱ. (sc. ἐπίθεμα, [[Exo.25.16-17|Exo.25:16-17]], where the word first occurs in LXX and where ἱ. ἐ. = כַּפֹּרֶת (which see in B_DB_, see word), elsewhere rendered simply τὸ ἱ; cf. Deiss., 124 ff.; Westc., He., in l), [[Heb.9.5|Heb.9:5]]†
(AS)

G2487.def:
**ἴχνος**, -εος (-ους), τό
[in LXX for כַּף, etc. ;]
**a track, footstep**: metaphorically (as frequently in cl.), στοιχεῖν τοῖς ἴ., [[Rom.4.12|Rom.4:12]] περιπατεῖν τοῖς ἴ., [[2Co.12.18|2Co.12:18]] ἐπακολουθεῖν τοῖς ἴ., [[1Pe.2.21|1Pe.2:21]] (cf. MM, _Exp._, xv).†
(AS)

G2418.def:
**ἱερουργέω**, -ῶ
(ἱερουργός, a sacrificing priest) [in LXX: [[4Ma.7.3|4Ma.7:3]] R (of. -γία, [[4Ma.3.30|4Mac 3:30]] א R)* ;]
**to perform sacred rites**; with accusative, to minister in priestly service (minister in sacrifice, R, mg.), τὸ εὐαγγέλιον, [[Rom.15.16|Rom.15:16]]†
(AS)

G2437.def:
**Ἰλλυρικόν**, -οῦ, τό
**Illyricum, a region bordering on the Adriatic Sea**: [[Rom.15.19|Rom.15:19]]†
(AS)

G2458.def:
**Ἰουνίας**, -α, ὁ
(or Ἰουνία, -ας, ἡ, Junia; AV, H, mg.)
**Junias**: [[Rom.16.7|Rom.16:7]]†
(AS)

G2413.def:
**ἱερός**, -ά, όν
[in LXX: [[Ezk.28.18|Eze.28:18]] (מִקְדָּשׁ); τό ἱ, [[1Ch.29.4|1Ch.29:4]] (בַּיִת), [[Ezk.45.19|Eze.45:19]] (עֲזָרָה); very frequently in I [[Est.1.1-58|Est.1:1-58]] -4 Mac ;]
1. in Hom., marvellous, mighty, divine.
2. (Also in Hom, and later cl.) consecrated to the deity, **sacred**: pl., ἱ. γράμματα, [[2Ti.3.15|2Ti.3:15]]
3. As subst.,
(a) (so in Hom.), τὰ ἱ., **sacrifices, sacred rites, sacred things**: [[1Co.9.13|1Co.9:13]]
(b) later, τὸ ἱ.,., **a consecrated or sacred place, a temple**: τ. Ἀρτέμιδος, [[Act.19.27|Act.19:27]] of the temple at Jerusalem, i.e. the entire precincts or some part thereof (as distinct from ὁ ναός, which see, the Sanctuary proper): [[1Co.9.13|1Co.9:13]], and frequently in Gosp. and esp. in Ac, [[Mat.12.6|Mat.12:6]], [[Mrk.13.3|Mrk.13:3]], [[Act.4.1|Act.4:1]], al. (on the use of ἱ. in Imperial Iuser., see Deiss., _LAE_, 380 f.)
(AS)

G2427.def:
**ἱκανόω**, -ῶ
(ἱκανός), [in LXX chiefly for רַב ;]
**to make sufficient, render fit**: with dupl. accusative, [[2Co.3.6|2Co.3:6]] with accusative of person(s) before εἰς, [[Col.1.12|Col.1:12]]†
(AS)

G2471.def:
**ἰσότης**, -ητος, ἡ
(ἴσος), [in LXX: [[Job.36.30|Job.36:30]], [[Zec.4.7|Zec.4:7]] * ;]
1. **equality**: [[2Co.8.13-14|2Co.8:13-14]]
2. **equity, fairness**: τὸ δίκαιον κ. τὴν ἰ., [[Col.4.1|Col.4:1]] (for dis­tinction bet. τὸ δ. and ἡ ἰ, see _ICC_, in l).†
(AS)

G2454.def:
**Ἰουδαϊσμός**, -οῦ, ὁ
(Ἰουδαΐζω), [in LXX: [[2Ma.2.21|2Ma.2:21]] [[2Mac.8.1|2Mac 8:1]] [[2Mac.14.38|2Mac 14:38]], [[4Ma.4.26|4Ma.4:26]] * ;]
**Judaism, the observance of Jewish rites**: [[Gal.1.13-14|Gal.1:13-14]]†
(AS)

G2477.def:
**ἱστορέω**, -ῶ
(ἵστωρ, one learned or skilled in) [in LXX: [[1Es.1.33|1Es.1:33]] [[Est.1.42|Est.1:42]] * ;]
1. with accusative of thing(s), to inquire into, learn by inquiry.
2. C. accusative of person(s), to inquire of or about.
3. to narrate, record.
4. **In late writers, to visit, become acquainted with**: [[Gal.1.18|Gal.1:18]] (see Ellic., in l, and cf. MM, _Exp._, xv).†
(AS)

G2450.def:
**Ἰουδαΐζω**
(Ἰουδαῖος), [in LXX: [[Est.8.17|Est.8:17]] (יָהַד hith.)* ;]
**to can-form to Jewish practice, to Judaize**: [[Gal.2.14|Gal.2:14]]†
(AS)

G2473.def:
**ἰσόψυχος -ον**
(ἴσος, ψυχή), [in LXX: [[Psa.55.13|Psa.55:13]] (עֵרֶךְ)* ;]
1. of equal spirit (Æsch., Agam., 1470).
2. **like-minded**: [[Php.2.20|Php.2:20]]†
(AS)

G2404.def:
**Ἱεράπολις** (WH, Ἱερὰ Πόλις), -εως, ἡ
**Hierapolis**: a city in the Lyons valley in the Province of Asia: [[Col.4.13|Col.4:13]]†
(AS)

G2412.def:
**ἱεροπρεπής**, -ές
(ἱερός, πρέπει) [in LXX: [[4Ma.9.25|4Ma.9:25]] [[4Mac.11.20|4Mac 11:20]] * ;]
**suited to a sacred character, reverend **(RV, reverent): [[Tit.2.3|Tit.2:3]] (cf. Tr., _Syn._, § xcii).†
(AS)

G2428.def:
**ἱκετήριος**, -α, -ον
(ἱκέτης, a suppliant), [in LXX: [[Job.40.22|Job.40:22]], [[2Ma.9.18|2Ma.9:18]] * ;]
**of a suppliant**; as subst., ἡ ἱ. (Sc. ῥάβδος),
1. in cl., an olive-branch, carried by a suppliant.
2. In late Gk. = ἱκεσία, **supplication**: pl., δεήσεις κ. ἱ., [[Heb.5.7|Heb.5:7]]
_SYN._: see: δέησις (AS)

G2462.def:
**ἵππος**, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for סוּס, sometimes for פָּרָשׁ, רֶכֶב ;]
**a horse**: [[Jas.3.3|Jas.3:3]], [[Rev.6.2|Rev.6:2]] ff. [[Rev.9.7|Rev.9:7]] ff. [[Rev.14.20; 18.13; 19.11|Rev.14:20 18:13 19:11]] ff,†
(AS)

G2406.def:
**ἱεράτευμα**, -τος, τό
(ἱερατεύω), [in LXX: βασίλειον ἱ., [[Exo.19.1-25; 6.1-30|Exo.19:1-25 6:1-30]] (כֹּהֵן מַמְלָכָה) [[Exo.23.22|Exo.23:22]], [[2Ma.2.17|2Ma.2:17]] * ;]
**a priesthood, body of priests**: ἱ ἅγιον, [[1Pe.2.5|1Pe.2:5]] βασ. ἱ, [[1Pe.2.9|1Pe.2:9]] (LXX, Ex, l.with).†
(AS)

G2472.def:
**ἰσότιμος**, -ον
(ἴσος, τιμή),
**equally privileged, held in equal honour**: πίστις, [[2Pe.1.1|2Pe.1:1]] (R, mg., equally precious, but v Field, _Notes_, 240; Mayor, in l).†
(AS)

G2434.def:
**ἱλασμός**, -οῦ
(ἱλάσκομαι), [in LXX: [[Lev.25.9|Lev.25:9]], [[Num.5.8|Num.5:8]] (כִּפֻּר), [[Psa.130.4|Psa.130:4]], Da TH [[Dan.9.9|Dan.9:9]] (סְלִיחָה), [[Amo.8.14|Amo.8:14]] (אַשְׁמָה), [[Ezk.44.27|Eze.44:27]] (חַטָּאָה), [[1Ch.28.20|1Ch.28:20]], [[Sir.18.20|Sir.18:20]] A, [[2Ma.3.33|2Ma.3:33]] * ;]
1. an appeasing (Plut.).
2. **a means of appeasing, propitiation **(Philo; Nu, Ez, ll.with): [[1Jn.2.2|1Jn.2:2]] [[Jhn.4.10|Jn 4:10]].
3. In LXX also forgiveness (Ps, Da TH, ll.with).†
(AS)

G2403.def:
**Ἰεζάβελ** (L, Ἰεζ-; Tr. -βέλ; Rec. -βήλ) ἡ, indecl. (Heb. אִיזֶבֶל; LXX as txt.; FlJ, Ἰεζαβέλη),
Jezebel ([[1Ki.16.31|3Ki.16:31]], al.): symbolically, [[Rev.2.20|Rev.2:20]] (see Swete, in l).†
(AS)

G2463.def:
**ἶρις**, -ιδος, ἡ
[in LXX: [[Exo.30.24|Exo.30:24]] (קִדָּה)*, (קֶשֶׁת, [[Gen.9.13|Gen.9:13]], [[Ezk.1.28|Eze.1:28]], is rendered by τόξον) ;]
1. Iris, the messenger of the gods.
2. **a rain­bow or halo**: [[Rev.4.3; 10.1|Rev.4:3 10:1]].
3. The plant Iris (cf. Ex., l.with).†
(AS)

G2466.def:
**Ἰσσαχάρ** (Rec. Ἰσαχ-, Ἰσασχ- (Elz.), T, -άχαρ), ὁ indecl. (FlJ, Ἰσάχαρις, Ἰσάσχ-) (Heb. יִשָּׂשכָר, [[Gen.30.18|Gen.30:18]]),
**Issachar**: [[Rev.7.7|Rev.7:7]]†
(AS)

G2461.def:
